title: Hidden UFO side of Operation Paperclip
summary: David Grusch tells of Hidden UFO side of Operation Paperclip, about post-WWII at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But there's this like other side of it that a lot of it dealt with the UFO, UAP issue in earnest.

plain: A former US intelligence officer named David Grusch tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Operation Paperclip, the American programme that brought German scientists such as the rocket engineers Wernher von Braun and Arthur Rudolph to the United States after the Second World War. Grusch says that there was another, hidden side to the programme, and that much of it dealt with UFOs in earnest. If true, it would mean the US government's interest in UFOs goes back to the end of the war.
